**Run log 404 fixed.** The `fs.stat(...).catch(() => null)` pattern in `run-log-store.ts` was swallowing my CF shim error as a "file not found", short-circuiting before my auto-fallback could see it. Routed log endpoints directly to the sidecar by path. Verified `GET /log` now returns 200.

**On the secondary errors you pasted:**

- **`Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')`** — that's the UI crashing because it tried to read `log.content.length` (or similar) when the log fetch returned 404 with no body. After today's fix the UI gets real content, so this should disappear. If it still surfaces with empty logs (legitimate empty case), it's a UI bug to defensively handle. Worth filing but not urgent.

- **`/ALM/skills/fb65cf15-...` Service Worker rejection** — the SW (`sw.js`) is registered to intercept fetches and is failing to convert the Worker's response to a Response object. `/ALM/skills/...` looks like a path the SW shouldn't be intercepting at all (it's a UI route, served by the SPA fallback). Likely the SW's pass-through for unknown URLs is broken. Separate bug, lives in `ui/public/sw.js` or wherever the SW is built. Low priority unless it causes user-visible problems.

**Status check before you reload the UI:**

Refresh the page. The run details should now display the log content, and the `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')` UI error should be gone (because logs are no longer 404). If anything else stays broken, paste the next failure and I'll continue.

Want me to also follow up on the `tsx watch` ignore issue I diagnosed earlier (workspace package edits not hot-reloading)? That's a real DX bug — every CF change you've seen me make has required a manual `dev:cf` restart, and that's why my retry fix didn't seem to take effect. I can fix that next so future fixes load automatically.
